title: TP4056 Charging Circuit Wiring
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Beginning Electronics
description: Interactive wiring diagram of a TP4056 charger module connected to a single-cell LiPo battery and a project board

learningObjectives: Identify which TP4056 pads the USB supply, the LiPo cell, and the project board connect to
Trace the charging current from the USB supply through the module into the cell
Explain why the project board is wired to OUT+/OUT- rather than B+/B-
Relate the R_PROG resistor to the module's charge current

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Interactive wiring diagram with a deliberate mis-wiring case
keyQuestions: Which pads does the battery connect to, and which pads does the project connect to?
What happens to the charge current as the cell approaches 4.2 V?
Why does a protected module cut the load off when the cell is empty?
commonMisconceptions: Any 5 V charger will charge a LiPo safely
The project board can be wired directly to B+/B- alongside the battery
The charge current is set by the USB supply rather than by R_PROG
assessmentOpportunities: Ask students to label B+, B-, OUT+, and OUT- from the photograph of a real module
Ask students to predict what happens when the load is wired to B+/B- and the USB is unplugged
